Oreo Pie
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 12:09am

Ingredients




1 9-inch graham or Oreo crust
1 pkt (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1 cup powdered sugar
1 pkt (8 oz.) instant vanilla pudding
1 ct , (16 oz.) cool whip
cup milk
20 Oreo cookies, crushed
1 teaspoon vanilla

Preparation

1 Beat cream cheese and sugar together. In another bowl, beat pudding and milk until thick. Add cool whip and vanilla to pudding. Add cream cheese mixture to pudding mixture, stirring well. Layer the cookies crumbs and the pudding mixture into crust beginning with a layer of cookie crumbs and reserving enough cookie crumbs to cover the top. 2 Yield: 8 servings
